custom_pages.title: Custom Pages
custom_pages.intro: Create standalone pages for your site.
custom_pages.empty: No custom pages have been created yet.
custom_pages.slug_help: Leave empty to create a slug from the title. Use lowercase letters, numbers and hyphens.
custom_pages.slug_locked_help: Published page URLs stay fixed so existing links keep working.
custom_pages.html_help: Use clean HTML. Allowed: paragraphs, h2–h6, lists, emphasis, links, quotes and code. Scripts, styles, images and custom attributes are removed when saved.
custom_pages.delete_confirm: Delete “{title}” permanently? This cannot be undone.

validation.slug_taken: This URL slug is already in use.
validation.slug_locked: The URL slug cannot change after the page has been published.
validation.body_too_long: Page content may contain at most 200,000 characters.
